Counter Attack Campaign

DRA is EVITA’s biggest competitor in Madhavaram, and the area was packed with DRA ads. Instead of playing the same game, we decided to counter it with a clever wordplay campaign built around EVITA’s USPs. A simple idea, a sharp execution, and a clear message enough to make the client extremely happy!

Campaign for Apollo Cancer Unit

This campaign is for proton therapy for cancer treatment - an advanced treatment option brought to Ahmedabad and made accessible to Indian patients by Apollo.

Therefore, the campaign primarily falls under Brand Awareness, with a focus on creating awareness about proton therapy and Apollo’s advanced cancer-care capabilities.

Campaign for Vwash

Public toilets can feel unhygienic and uncomfortable, but sometimes they are unavoidable. The idea is to highlight this everyday concern and position VWash as an essential hygiene companion that helps women feel fresh, clean, and confident wherever they are.
